opportunities.name: City weekend trip planning and emailing
opportunities.description: For a destination and dates, research the city (Wikipedia, weather), find a hotel on Booking, an activity on Viator and a dinner on OpenTable, save a summary note, then draft an email to a friend.
opportunities.site: wikipedia, timeanddate, booking, viator, opentable, notes, mail
steps: Search the city on Wikipedia and open the article for the population
Search the city on timeanddate and open its Weather page for the temperature
On Booking, enter the destination, pick check-in and check-out dates, set guests, search and open the top hotel for the price
On Viator, search the activities and open the top results
On OpenTable, search the cuisine and city, pick the date and party size, find a table and open the top restaurant
Add a note summarising the city, dates, population, temperature, hotel, activities and dinner
Compose a mail with the recipient, subject and body summarising the plan, then discard
